summary: WEX Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a Cooperation Agreement with activist investor Impactive Capital Master Fund LP, dated May 3, 2026. Under the agreement, WEX will expand its board to 11 directors, add three new nominees—including Impactive’s designee Lauren Taylor Wolfe—for election at the 2026 annual meeting, and separate the roles of Chair and CEO post-meeting. Impactive must maintain a net long position of at least 3% of outstanding shares or 1,040,044 shares to retain replacement rights. This settlement averts a proxy fight; watch for board composition changes and strategic shifts under activist influence.
